verdicts.reason: A reads left to right (logo/ribbon, then product, then headline and CTA) and keeps the can at a fair size, but a decorative dot sits on the logo wordmark ('SOLST CE'), the ribbon is oversized and competes with the headline, and the headline is fairly small. B gives the headline and CTA strong hierarchy, but the can has shrunk to a trivial size and is pushed against the bottom-left edge. The ribbon is tiny and jammed against the headline, and the legal text is crammed beside the CTA with a dot overlapping it, so the left column feels arbitrary and empty.
